text: We often celebrate high completion rates, but we rarely ask who is left behind along the way. If your course isn't navigable via screen readers or lacks accurate transcripts, you're inadvertently excluding a segment of your audience before they even hit module one. We need to move beyond just making great content and start auditing for inclusive design. True engagement isn't just about the curriculum; it's about ensuring every student has the tools to actually cross the finish line.
